subject: Lake Chad
hook: LAKE CHAD IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: Lake Chad is no longer shrinking; despite persistent narratives of its disappearance, the lake's water volume has stabilized due to a partial recovery in rainfall.
angle_support: The lake is now no longer estimated to be shrinking, as rainfall recovery has partially occurred.
Despite the stabilisation of the lake's water volume, Lake Chad is still under threat from climate change.
title: The Truth About Lake Chad's Size
description: Contrary to popular belief, Lake Chad is not disappearing. While it faced a massive decline in the 20th century, current measurements show the water levels have stabilized.
narration: LAKE CHAD IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture a desert landscape where a legendary African lake has vanished into dust. It was closer to a story of stabilization after a period of extreme loss. Between 1960 and 1980, the lake's open water area plummeted from 25,000 square kilometers to just 2,000. However, recent data confirms the water volume is no longer shrinking due to a partial recovery in annual rainfall. The basin is currently holding its ground against the shifting climate.
